This sandbox example shows the campaign button beside advice that makes it useful. It is a preview of future article placement and is excluded from the production article collection.

## Start with the companies you can help

Define the accounts by the characteristics that affect your ability to deliver. An industry label alone may include companies with very different needs, budgets and operating structures.

Describe the territory, company size and situation that make a prospect worth approaching. Keep exclusions beside those criteria so the list builder can avoid companies that would consume time without a sensible fit.

## Connect the buyer role to a useful opening

Identify who experiences the problem and who can approve a response to it. An operations leader may recognise the disruption while a finance leader wants to understand its cost and priority.

Choose an opening that gives that person a clear reason to continue the conversation. The preview below turns your selections into an example approach and points you toward resources that fit the campaign you are considering.

{% set contextToolCta = contextualTools.campaign %}{% include "components/contextual-tool-cta.njk" %}

## Agree on what makes a meeting useful

Write down the information a salesperson needs before taking the first meeting. Relevant responsibility, a credible business issue and a clear purpose for the discussion are more useful than an empty calendar slot.

Decide which questions belong on the initial call and which require your subject-matter expert. Keeping that boundary clear helps the caller qualify interest without pretending to have every technical answer.

## Give the sales team enough context to continue

Carry the buyer's own description of the issue into the meeting notes. The seller can then prepare a focused conversation instead of making the prospect repeat the entire story.

Use the [campaign strategy resources](/resources/outbound-campaign-strategy/) to organise your next questions. When you are ready to discuss execution, [book a conversation with CallTeam](https://calendly.com/hello-callteam/new-meeting) and bring the brief you want us to review.
